dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: A village can provide troops, conceal provisions, assist with reconnaissance, and so on... They often function as key strategic locations in resistance operations.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: The layout of this village is quite conventional, I doubt anyone could point to anything that's out of place. You've clearly done your homework on Inazuma's environment!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I am thoroughly impressed by your abilities.
